facts.summary: Missed primary endpoint vs placebo; female subgroup signal · Phase 3 KOASTAL-1 · navacaprant in major depressive disorder · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Study did not demonstrate statistically significant improvement on primary endpoint of reduction in depressive symptoms as measured by MADRS total score compared to placebo
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The study did not demonstrate a statistically significant improvement on the primary endpoint of change from baseline in the Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) total score at Week 6
evidence.safety: Navacaprant was shown to be safe and generally well-tolerated with no serious adverse events reported.
evidence.program_discontinued: The Phase 3 KOASTAL-2, KOASTAL-3 and KOASTAL-LT studies are ongoing.
